scope: Inspect the frozen changed-photograph PDF independently of its builder QA. Review every page visually, enlarge all seven requested critical pages, and compare PDF vector overlays with saved labels on those seven pages. This task does not modify the PDF, labels or renderer.

rendering.contact_sheet_method: Two unscaled 96-dpi page renders stacked vertically with a separate 28-pixel page-number header for each render; the final sheet contains only page 35.

saved_label_overlay_comparison.method: Read exact saved r19 and r18 rows, independently derive numerical changed groups, map saved normalized coordinates into each PDF embedded-image rectangle, then match actual PDF box rectangles and point circles/squares by geometry and field color. Count all visible markers to detect missing or extra point overlays.

programmatic_qa_results_cross_referenced.source: Values reported by the hash-bound builder QA; visual inspection independently found no contradictory issue.

named_case_observations.observation: The revised right box boundary is magenta and ends at the visible cassette edge before the finger. The retained left marker remains cyan; the missing right marker stays absent and is listed in the footer.

Selected rack-trimmed boxes are magenta while retained left/right markers remain cyan. Row 20 is the exception: its corrected right front corner is magenta at x=766 pixels, independently of its magenta box ending at x=766.5 pixels.

The magenta right box boundary stops at the cassette/finger junction. Its retained left marker is cyan and its missing right marker remains absent. The row tag is relocated above the narrow front and remains readable.

Rows 1–3 and 31 have magenta boxes with retained cyan corner markers. Row 1 includes the projecting upper rim with ymin=398 pixels and retains its bottom boundary; the retained row 4 provides the upper-rim comparison. Rows 2 and 3 use the saved immutable anchors without shifting their point markers.

Rows 15 and 16 show inset magenta left markers on the lower front-face junctions, at approximately (962.6,64.06) and (955.2,111.28) pixels. Their boxes and right markers remain cyan. Row 14 remains cyan and provides the adjacent comparison. All tags and the Left: 15-16 caption are readable.

Restored row 32 has a magenta left circle at (941,518) pixels, visibility 2, while its box and right marker remain cyan. Its point is inset from the outer side silhouette at the front-face junction, consistent with nearby corrected corners. Row 32 is absent from the missing-left footer. Rows 7–8 distinguish changed boxes and left points; rows 15–16 distinguish changed boxes from retained cyan points.

Only the corrected left markers 7, 8 and 27 are magenta; all boxes remain cyan. The user reference left markers 31–33 remain cyan and sit at the inward front-face junctions, preserving their role as retained examples. Missing right markers 31–32 remain absent.

visual_conclusions: The linked index and all 34 changed-photo pages are readable, with consistent spacing, intact original camera framing and unclipped captions.
Cyan retained fields and magenta changed fields are visually distinct. No amber, question or held-case display appears.
Dense row tags remain readable and relocated tags retain clear leaders; no overlap requiring correction was observed.
Original RGB content is preserved exactly in every embedded photograph. The inspected critical overlays correspond to exact saved label geometry within PDF serialization precision.
The restored 127:32 left point and corrected 114:15–16 left points are shown as changes; retained 128:31–33 reference points remain cyan.
limitations: This is PDF rendering and saved-label consistency QA, not a new certification of every physical annotation. All 35 pages were visually inspected; detailed independent vector-coordinate checks cover the seven named critical photographs.
Tag text is 7.2 points on A3 landscape pages. It is readable in the inspected unscaled 96-dpi sheets and enlarged critical pages, while screen fit-to-window views may require zoom.
Rendering PNGs and contact sheets are diagnostic workspace artifacts. Their exact paths and hashes record what was viewed; the frozen PDF and repository ledger are the durable deliverables.
